edits: - [ ] **Separate new-actor initialization from retained prose conversion.** `WorldService` startup calls `migrateCognition`, which calls `migrateKnowledge` in `packages/domain/src/knowledge-migration.ts`. When policy or per-actor knowledge is absent, that path injects `BASE_KNOWLEDGE_POLICY`, moves non-protected inner-world files into a general note and rewrites the originating mind. The same initializer also serves fresh-world/capability creation. The adjacent `initializeActorTraits` startup hook also fills every memory-capable actor’s absent traits with three entries from the bundled trait bank. Remove that world-specific repair from generic loading; retain deliberate world-owned creation/capability initialization and preserve explicit empty trait lists. An absent optional trait field in an otherwise supported world is not by itself permission to inject human dispositions or a reason to add a blanket rejection rule. Keep legitimate current actor initialization with its authored world owner, but remove older-layout prose conversion and missing-policy substitution from loading; reject incompatible input while retaining its bytes and accounting. Preserve protected identity, normal empty knowledge creation, note revisions and source/privacy semantics. Trace creation and capability callers before replacing this shared initializer; a historical name alone is not proof that all its work is obsolete.
files.summary: track bundled-trait injection in the existing startup compatibility cleanup
